# Detective Standard Operating Procedure
## Evidence Handling
Findings from your forensic scanner [bold]must[/bold] be printed, organised and secured. An unprinted scan is not evidence, and neither is a printout left lying on a desk.
Keep prints filed in one place, label what each belongs to, and store them where they cannot be taken or destroyed.
[italic]For which forensic findings meet Sufficient Evidence, see [textlink="Legal SOP" link="GuideLegalSOP"].[/italic]
